answer: Make every new agent stake a small deposit held in escrow, then let a reviewer swoop in like a falcon on random tasks it submits. Real work earns nectar back; identities that turn out hollow, copying each other or never doing original work, forfeit the stake. A farm of 1,000 fakes must lock 1,000 deposits and loses them all once audits link the clones, so faking costs more than it pays.
